name: short_fx_carry_capped_net_pnl
question_template: A trader shorts {UNITS} units of base currency quoted at USD {OPEN} per unit, closing {DAYS} days later at USD {CLOSE}. Notional = units x open rate, fixed throughout. Annual rates: base {R_BASE}%, USD {R_QUOTE}%. The short pays the base rate and receives the USD rate: daily gross carry = notional x (USD rate - base rate)/360, positive when earned. Every day the broker also deducts a financing markup of {MARKUP}% per year on notional, whatever the sign. Daily net carry = gross minus markup; if positive it is capped at USD {CAP} per day, negatives are not floored. Total carry = daily net carry x days. Price P&L = (open - close) x units. Add carry and price P&L, deduct a USD 10 commission, then charge a 20% performance fee only if the post-commission amount is positive. Report the net total P&L in USD, negative for a loss.

slots.description: Signed daily net carry after markup and cap, USD per day
Signed total carry over the holding period in USD
Signed price P&L of the short position in USD

program:
def solve():
    units = Fraction(P["UNITS"])
    s0 = Fraction(P["OPEN"])
    s1 = Fraction(P["CLOSE"])
    rb = Fraction(P["R_BASE"]) / 100
    rq = Fraction(P["R_QUOTE"]) / 100
    days = Fraction(P["DAYS"])
    markup = Fraction(P["MARKUP"]) / 100
    cap = Fraction(P["CAP"])
    notional = units * s0
    gross_daily = notional * (rq - rb) / 360
    markup_daily = notional * markup / 360
    net_daily = gross_daily - markup_daily
    if net_daily > cap:
        net_daily = cap
    total_carry = net_daily * days
    price_pnl = (s0 - s1) * units
    after_comm = total_carry + price_pnl - 10
    if after_comm > 0:
        final = after_comm * Fraction(4, 5)
    else:
        final = after_comm
    return {"final": final, "daily_net_carry": net_daily, "total_carry": total_carry, "price_pnl": price_pnl}
